capabilities.description: Free-body force accumulation, mass properties and pose/velocity lifecycle
capabilities.remaining: The resident runtime connects native body upload, world inertia, gravity, integration, finalization and live pose/velocity edits. Full current-source matrix qualification remains; unused Rust Force/Impulse convenience methods are not a separate Python object API.

capabilities.description: Complete 3D Coulomb contact preparation and solution
capabilities.remaining: Prepared colors, recycling, warmstart, biased/unbiased solve and caches are connected to the public runtime. Native fused/tail launches are intentionally represented by ordered colors; native schedule equivalence and full scene/restart evidence are required.

capabilities.description: Brute-force broad phase
capabilities.remaining: All native brute-force entry points and composed fixture scenes are covered. The public portable backend uses LBVH; brute force remains a tested alternative kernel path, not a separate public runtime mode. Performance and Ascend execution are unqualified.

capabilities.description: LBVH construction, refit and traversal
capabilities.remaining: All 3D LBVH stages connect native multi-collider uploads to resident build/refit/traversal and pre-commit pair capacity growth. Current full-matrix evidence and Ascend synchronization remain to be qualified.

capabilities.description: Primitive shape bounds, support maps and contact generation
capabilities.remaining: Analytic contact generation and native Shape point-query wrappers are connected and independently checked. Final current-source qualification remains.

capabilities.description: GJK, EPA, SAT and polygonal contact manifolds
capabilities.remaining: Native 3D support, GJK, EPA, SAT, secondary-witness clipping and general manifold scenes are implemented. Full-matrix current-source qualification remains; Ascend private-memory compilation and performance remain untested.

capabilities.description: Triangle meshes, polylines and composite traversal
capabilities.remaining: Mesh/polyline traversal, subshape conversion, sorting, reduction, point queries and pseudonormals are implemented. Public runtime retries both pair and deferred-work overflow before commit. Final current-source qualification remains.

capabilities.description: Ray and point queries
capabilities.remaining: Projection, support, mesh/ray and native Shape local/world solid/boundary wrappers have registered contracts. Native singular/default behavior stays explicit. Final current-source qualification remains.

capabilities.description: Contact matching, recycling and impulse transfer
capabilities.remaining: Matching, geometry reuse and model-specific impulse transfer are connected to live runtime, checkpoint continuation and model switching. Final native scene/restart matrix qualification remains.

capabilities.description: Coloring, buckets and production color dispatch
capabilities.remaining: Adjacency, seeded Topo coloring, buckets and pre-commit palette/completion checks are connected. The runtime grows palette/round limits or returns an explicit capacity error. Native Luby primitives remain tested; the public backend selects deterministic Topo. Final qualification remains.

capabilities.description: Mass splitting, hub gather and synchronization
capabilities.remaining: Native hub allocation/splitting, warmstart, scatter and cooperative averaging are connected to resident frames and public capacity migration. One/two 33-contact plate comparisons are required; Ascend hardware synchronization remains untested.

capabilities.description: Impulse joints and joint constraints
capabilities.remaining: Ordinary joint motors, limits, preparation and colored iterations connect native arbitrary scene upload to resident stepping, configuration and scene reconstruction. Native coupled-axis restrictions remain unchanged. Final current-source qualification remains.

capabilities.description: Multibody dynamics, constraints, sensors and reset
capabilities.remaining: Unported.

capabilities.description: Twist-friction model
capabilities.remaining: Compact twist arithmetic, preparation, caches, color/hub scheduling and public model switching are connected. Required native full scenes and identical-state restarts cover contact-sensitive fields. Final current-source qualification remains.

capabilities.description: Scan, reduction, sorting and compaction
capabilities.remaining: Native prefix hierarchy and radix stages/sorts are ported. Typed layouts, batch indexing and slice access lower to derived offsets and direct buffer operations. Matrix utilities used only by articulated multibodies stay deferred. Final current-source qualification remains.

capabilities.description: Canonical ordering and deterministic schedules
capabilities.remaining: Canonical contacts, stable adjacency, deterministic bounded Topo with completion feedback and ordered color dependencies connect to the public runtime. Exact IDs/guards remain mandatory; nondeterministic hub allocation is validated by semantic ownership. Floating point is tolerance-based. Final current-source qualification remains.

capabilities.description: Public API, production scene stepping and runtime integration
capabilities.remaining: Rust-owned backend selection, native scene upload, resident stepping, lazy capacity/color growth, live controls, model switching, checkpoints and scene reconstruction are implemented. Full current-source matrix and offline handoff qualification remain. Ascend execution adapter/toolkit testing awaits hardware.
